snippet.title: Cristiano Ronaldo Family Timeline (1985–2024) | Family Chronology
snippet.description:
In this video, we follow the family timeline of Cristiano Ronaldo - from his early roots in Madeira to his rise as one of the most iconic footballers in history.

Cristiano Ronaldo was born in Funchal, Madeira, in 1985 and became one of the most successful athletes of all time. His journey took him from a young boy with a dream to Sporting CP, Manchester United, Real Madrid, Juventus, Al-Nassr, and the Portugal national team.

But behind the goals, trophies, records, and global fame is a powerful family story. This timeline follows Cristiano Ronaldo, his family roots, Georgina Rodríguez, his children, and the people closest to him across the years.

From childhood to fatherhood, from football history to family legacy - this is the story of Cristiano Ronaldo’s family line.
